title: U.S. House · New York's 21st District
area: The North Country: St. Lawrence, Jefferson, Lewis, Franklin, Clinton, Essex, Hamilton, Fulton and Warren counties, plus parts of Saratoga and Herkimer counties in far northern New York.

context.text: This is an open seat. Incumbent Republican Elise Stefanik did not seek re-election to the House. She had run for Governor of New York but withdrew from that race on December 19, 2025.

Blake Gendebien defeated Stuart Amoriell in the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary, 64.5%-35.0%. Anthony Constantino defeated Robert Smullen in the June 23, 2026 Republican primary, 59.2%-40.3%; Smullen remains on the general-election ballot on the Conservative Party line.

priorities.text: Affordability, including repealing what he describes as costly and unnecessary government regulations, supporting fair trade deals and bringing back American manufacturing to lower costs for working families.
Healthcare access in rural communities, including expanding telehealth, lowering prescription drug costs, and opposing cuts to Social Security, Medicare or Medicaid.
Government reform, saying he wants to end the "elected to lobbyist" pipeline and get dark money out of politics.
priorities.quote: I'm committed to cleaning up Washington and I will always be responsive to the voters of the North Country, not special interests.

positions.summary: Says he will protect a woman's right to choose and opposes new regulations imposing total abortion bans, including in cases of rape or when the mother's life is at stake.
Says he will never vote to cut Social Security, Medicare or Medicaid and wants to expand telehealth and lower prescription drug costs.

In a 2026 Protect the Adirondacks questionnaire, he said human use of fossil fuels is a major driver of climate change, supported the core principle of the Polluters Pay Climate Fund Act, and called for investment in clean energy such as regional hydropower.
positions.quote: I support the core principle of this legislation.

candidates.name: Anthony Constantino
candidates.currentRole: Founder and CEO of Sticker Mule

priorities.text: Says he is self-funding his campaign to be free of special-interest influence and does not ask for donations.
Addressing illegal immigration, citing his fluency in Spanish and stating open borders have caused suffering in the U.S. and abroad.
Healthcare policy focused on innovation and outcomes rather than what he describes as an endless debate over making it free.

positions.summary: Told North Country Now he supports the Trump administration's immigration crackdowns and criticized Gov. Hochul's order banning local-federal 287(g) enforcement agreements.
positions.quote: I think it's terrible. The reason the governor strips these agreements, I don't know.

positions.summary: In a Feb. 21, 2025 campaign post, said he would work to repeal federal gun control and restrictions imposed by the ATF.
positions.quote: In Congress, I will fight to make the Second Amendment great again by repealing federal gun control, slashing unconstitutional regulations imposed by rogue agencies like the ATF, and ultimately restoring the right to keep and bear arms for all Americans.

positions.summary: An Oct. 12, 2026 campaign press release states he is pro-life, with exceptions for rape, incest and the life of the mother, and will oppose taxpayer funding of abortion.
positions.quote: Constantino is pro-life, with exceptions only in cases of rape, incest, and when the life of the mother is at risk. In Congress, he will oppose taxpayer funding of abortion

candidates.name: Christopher Schmidt
candidates.ballotNote: Write-in candidate on the general-election ballot

priorities.text: Says his campaign focuses on local issues such as housing, healthcare access, and employment challenges in the region, an independent approach to legislation, and community engagement with residents' feedback.
priorities.quote: Focus on local issues: Highlights the importance of addressing housing, healthcare access, and employment challenges in the region.

priorities.text: Lists government accountability and transparency, housing and infrastructure, energy and utilities, economic and workforce issues, and healthcare access as the public-policy areas he is most passionate about.
priorities.quote: Government accountability and transparency: Emphasizing oversight, ethics, and public trust in institutions.

researchNotes: Christopher Schmidt (write-in) completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey (https://ballotpedia.org/Christopher_Schmidt_(New_York)), which supplied his priorities above; Ballotpedia's page for him has no separate biography section and lists no campaign website, so no background items or issue positions could be sourced. Federal key votes and FEC totals are added separately by script for sitting members of Congress; this is an open seat so no candidate has those. Pass 2 (Oct. 2026): added gun and abortion positions from his campaign posts and press releases; the abortion position is stated in a campaign press release rather than in a direct quotation from him. Biography gaps: Schmidt's public record contains no education, career or residence details; Gendebien's and Constantino's biographies rely on their own materials and a WAMC profile, and no full news profile of Gendebien was found.
